report.summary: daedalus/structcore/typegraph.py: Resolves raw type annotations into directed edges over a separate type/node namespace, with two-pass resolution and published coverage counts.
risks: CLAIMS|daedalus/structcore/typegraph.py|determinism via sorted iterations and total order
SMELL|daedalus/structcore/typegraph.py|Large module combining node id generation, naming, resolution, and outcome types; potential for splitting

daedalus/structcore/typegraph.py|function|type_node_id|Returns a forest node id for a type declaration.
